OV4 · Representative framework paths at c423c51e · LOCAL and SOCKET_IPC are build alternatives
API boundary ≠ IPC boundary ≠ thread boundary. SAL hides stack choice; VHAL/driver contracts hide controller and bus details.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
